'''Tereez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] living in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Tereez was employed by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], while he was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], as his wardrobe designer. Later the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] hired her to be her personal custom designer. While employed by Charn she lived aboard the ''[[Nova's Heart]]''.
